title: Execution Authorization View
description: Externally observable view of an AGCP Execution Authorization. Execution Authorization validates whether an authorized governance decision remains eligible for Commit Boundary processing; it does not itself execute the Action.

authorized_for_commit_boundary.description: True only when authorization_outcome is Authorized for Commit Boundary Processing.

governance_decision_ref.description: Reference to the Governance Decision Result that forms the basis for this Execution Authorization.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration time after which this authorization SHALL NOT be used for Commit Boundary processing.

consumed_at.description: Timestamp at which this authorization was consumed by successful Commit Boundary processing, if applicable.

authorization_basis.description: Implementation-independent basis for the authorization outcome.

metadata.description: Implementation-defined metadata that SHALL NOT alter normative authorization semantics.
